name: snapkit-debug-sync
description: Debug Dashboard-selected Flutter devices without modifying project files; fall back to normal IDE debugging offline.

snapkit.useDashboardTargets.description: Use Dashboard targets for native Run/Debug when the local agent is available and the project matches. Otherwise use the normal IDE configuration.

snapkit.agentUrl.description: Loopback HTTP address of the local Snapkit agent. Debugging continues normally when this agent is offline.

snapkit.syncFlutterRestart.description: The IDE Restart button also hot restarts other running Flutter debug sessions.
